values: Executive readout of field coverage, corrected mappings and decisions required. Detailed evidence is in the other four sheets.

Decision rule

Only an Exact association can be treated as a direct field mapping.

Partial associations require explicit caveats. Derived fields require an approved rule and version. Gaps must remain visible—never filled by a convenient proxy.

Reporting visibility proves a read path only. It does not prove a production write path, gate, approval, or compliance control.
No economic-owner carrier exists in current Canix reporting. brand_id / brand_name remain commercial labels only.
Use quantity_type + unit fields, with WeightBased grams and CountBased units separated; the UX OS basis is still missing.
Cost Object is not Sales Order Line
order_item_id and sales_order_id are allocation/order context and cannot replace cost_object_id.
Release and transfer events were conflated
marked_available_date and packaged_date have precise meanings; neither proves CCO release or transfer.
The draft's Canix domain count is outdated
The current connector exposes five domains: cultivation, inventory, lab_tests, procurement and sales.
The draft's AR conclusion is too broad
Payment rows and order-balance fields are now visible. Invoice identity, due date, terms and aging remain gaps.
Harvest-to-package edges are available, but complete package-to-package split/combine genealogy is not in current reporting schemas.
Approve the canonical ownership and UOM definitions before adding Canix custom fields.
Validate Canix carriers/write paths for cost_object_id, ownership, order_source, license expiry and HOLD/COD.
Use a separate traceability read for complete package genealogy; retain the current package inventory view for on-hand state.
Inspect QuickBooks for invoice/due-date/terms authority, then define the deterministic Canix order ↔ invoice link.
